fun_facts: At age 7, Justin Herbert entered a track meet in his hometown of Eugene and competed in the softball throw; after a string of wins, he made it to a national meet in Hershey, Pennsylvania.
Justin Herbert was a three-sport star at Sheldon High School in Eugene, Oregon.
In 2016, Justin Herbert became Oregon’s first true freshman to start at quarterback in 33 years.
Justin Herbert ran for three touchdowns in Oregon’s Rose Bowl win, becoming the first quarterback to do that in the Rose Bowl since Vince Young.
As a senior at Oregon in 2019, Justin Herbert threw for 3,471 yards and 32 touchdowns.
